// diagnostic E0314

Jet.NumberFamilySize

`{written}` is no size of the `{name}` family

What

`{written}` is no size of the `{name}` family

Why

a number family has only its standard sizes: {sizes}

Fix

use a standard size, or a range type such as `Int(0..127)` for a narrower set of values

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.NumberFamilySize: Tests/UI/number_family_has_only_standard_sizes.stderr.

Error: Jet.NumberFamilySize: `Unsigned<24>` is no size of the `Unsigned` family
  --> Tests/UI/number_family_has_only_standard_sizes.jet:2:12
    |
  2 |     value: Unsigned<24>,
    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A number family has only its standard sizes: `Unsigned<8>`, `Unsigned<16>`, `Unsigned<32>` and `Unsigned<64>`
 Fix: Use a standard size, or a range type such as `Int(0..127)` for a narrower set of values
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.NumberFamilySize
